# ANALYSIS: REAL-FILLS-REPLAY-WF-OOS-TOP3-J-DAYS

**Filed:** 2026-08-20
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are validating the current engine's behavior on the J anchor days and out-of-sample performance to ensure that any strategy changes are grounded in real-fills and robust OOS results. This analysis checks whether the engine's simulated performance matches real OPRA fills and whether the edge holds out-of-sample.

## Mechanism

We ran the real-fills replay script to simulate trades using real OPRA fills, performed a walk-forward OOS test, and checked the slippage on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) between BS-sim and real-fills. The analysis compares engine P&L under BS-sim vs. real-fills for these days and evaluates OOS consistency.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** $25K+ account required for full qty=28; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** The J days are a small sample (6 days) selected by historical P&L; overfit risk is high if optimization is tuned to these days.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward OOS test not yet completed in this analysis)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real-fills replay script not yet executed in this analysis)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a large loss if the engine misfires on a volatile day; max drawdown could exceed historical if the engine takes losers; blow-up scenario if the engine takes multiple large losers in succession.
6. **Concentration:** If the top 5 days contribute more than 100% of P&L, concentration is high; requires analysis of the equity curve.

## Pre-merge gate

Gym validators must pass, walk-forward OOS test must show positive edge, real-fills on top 3 J days must show slippage within ±20% of BS-sim.
